map.APC 和 MPC 区别？: What is the difference between APC and MPC?
map.APC 是总消费/总收入（水平量），MPC 是消费增量/收入增量（边际量），后者: APC is total consumption / total income (a level quantity), while MPC is the change in consumption / change in income (a marginal quantity), and the latter is what enters the multiplier. map.APS=1−APC，二者互补，APC 降则储蓄率升。结果仅作经济学教学与快速测算: APS = 1 - APC; the two are complementary, so a lower APC means a higher saving rate.
